Carlos M.: Hi @people-ops — need help. My cousin (minor) will move in with me under a temporary guardian letter from abroad. Can I add them to health/dental now? Passport and SSN pending due to visa backlog.
Lena (People Ops): Hi Carlos Welcome. You can open a QLE today. We need placement/guardian docs + proof of residence. Passport/SSN can follow. Are the guardian docs notarized?
Carlos M.: Notarized by local authority but not translated. Courier delay for certified English translation.
Diane (Benefits): We treat this like a QLE for custody/guardianship. Required: 1) guardian/placement order, 2) proof of shared residence (lease, utility, school email), 3) birth certificate or equivalent. If translation is delayed we can accept original + a sworn translation to mark pending.
Carlos M.: Cool. If I enroll now and translation arrives later, will payroll premiums be charged from placement date?
Diane (Benefits): If you enroll within 30 days of placement (placement date is date on guardian docs) coverage is retroactive to that date. Payroll adjustments are applied retroactively once People Ops approves.
Carlos M.: 30 days might be tight because the visa office is slow. Any flexibility?
Lena (People Ops): We can escalate for documentation delays related to visa/immigration. When you submit, add a short timeline and attach courier/tracking receipts. We may grant an exception if you show good-faith attempts.
Carlos M.: Where do I upload? Any filename convention?
Diane (Benefits): Upload in the benefits portal -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent (QLE). Name files like carlos-hernandez-guardian.pdf and carlos-hernandez-translation.pdf. Include a note: "Pending passport/SSN; requesting provisional acceptance."
BenefitsBot: Ticket created: #BFT-3421. Status: awaiting docs. Payroll flag: pending-retro-adjustment.
Carlos M.: One more: does adding this dependent affect my FSA dependent care or HSA eligibility?
Diane (Benefits): Yes, once enrolled they qualify as a dependent for DC FSA and HSA dependent rules (subject to plan definitions). For DC FSA you can start claiming eligible expenses once coverage is active; we'll confirm effective date on approval.
Carlos M.: And what about COBRA if something weird happens later?
Lena (People Ops): If this dependent later loses eligibility (e.g., guardianship ends) they would be a qualifying COBRA event for their coverage in some cases. We can counsel you on scenarios once enrollment is complete.
Carlos M.: Ok uploading docs now (guardian.pdf, lease-prop-attest.pdf, courier-tracking.pdf). Thanks!
Diane (Benefits): Got it 44d We'll review within 3 business days; exceptions may take 5-7. We'll post updates here.
Carlos M.: Appreciate it :pray:
